name: Agent Safety Atlas research universe
scopePolicy: agent-safety-v3 (5,649 works), agent-safety-v4 (3,312 works), unrecorded (34 works)
description: Deduplicated research works on the safety and security of LLM-based and learned agents, with typed relations that keep their basis, editorial clusters, automatic candidate clusters, institutions, and the observation report computed on this release.

relationTypes.cites: A's Semantic Scholar reference list contains B; contexts and intents are Semantic Scholar's when available (record-level otherwise)
relationTypes.uses_benchmark: a sentence in A's full text evaluates on, adopts or reports results on benchmark B; spot-check precision 86.1% (n = 79), roughly half of uses found

definitions.referenceGroup: (cluster, publication year, form), falling back to (cluster, year) then year

sources.terms: arXiv states its metadata is available under CC0 1.0

sources.used_for: reference lists, citation counts, citing sentences and intents
sources.terms: Semantic Scholar API License Agreement; attribution required
bibliographic metadata facts; Crossref states most metadata has no use restrictions
bibliographic facts with source URLs; no text redistributed
GitHub Terms of Service; repository metadata only

sources.source: Paper full texts (arXiv HTML/PDF, open-access copies)
sources.terms: not redistributed; only short quoted sentences as evidence

sources.used_for: content vectors for layout, candidate clusters and relevance
sources.terms: model released under Apache 2.0; vectors not redistributed, 2-D positions only

sources.used_for: scope decisions, clusters, forms, summaries, audits
sources.terms: licence to be chosen by the owner (for example CC BY 4.0)

knownLimits: Coverage depends on the sources; a missing relation means not recorded, not unrelated.
Institution addresses are not nationalities; 21% of works have no located institution.
Benchmark use is matched by name in local full texts: a lower bound with ~85% precision.
Attack/defence labels in the onset analysis are title keywords and are not audited.
Statuses of hypotheses are observations on one release, not tests on held-out data.
11 registry (ROR) matches judged wrong were corrected: 67 papers re-attributed to the institution printed in the paper (data-sources/corrections/).
recompute: python collect_citation_graph.py   # Semantic Scholar records (ids cached)
citation: DOI to be assigned when the release is deposited
